name: Two Lips, Two Lungs and One Tongue

podcast.body: This song is featured on NoMeansNo's album "Wrong," released in 1989. The album was popular and admired by Kurt Cobain. "This is called Two Lips, Two Lungs and One Tongue."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is from No Means No's 1989 album, "WRONG," which was released on Alternative Tentacles and was a favorite of Kurt Cobain. "This is called Two Lips, Two Lungs and One Tongue."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
